arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT)
arguments.explanation: Counts the transactions that have a fraud label (whether that label is fraud or not fraud).
assumptions: "Have a fraud label" means any label is present (is_fraud 0 or 1). It does not mean the transaction is labelled as fraud.
